How a swing qualifies

Why an 80-cent print is not an 80-cent move

An alert is published when the reference price of a market moves by at least $0.10 either way and the quote it moves to is a real market price: two-sided, with a bid–ask width of at most $0.50. A quote with only one side is not published either: with no opposite side there is nothing to check it against.

Without that gate the feed filled with phantom crashes: e.g. KXPRESNOMD-28-AKLO has a real book of $0.002 bid / $0.003 ask, yet a lone $0.8030 ask prints for a single minute and reverts, and the mid swings $0.8030 → $0.0025 → $0.8030 every few minutes. Kalshi returns bids only, so a single unpaired print has no opposite side to check against — see Orderbook Responses ↗. Those rows are kept in the Flagged for review log with their API links, not deleted.
